say:2:1710819002:1.text: It's him! It's really King Rolan!
say:2:1710819002:1.source_cn: 是他！真的是他！罗兰大帝！

say:5:1710819004:1.text: As absurd as this farce has been, there is an unexpected benefit.
say:5:1710819004:1.source_cn: 这场闹剧虽然荒唐，但也有一个意外之喜。

say:6:1710819005:1.text: It has brought into light the true puppet master lurking in the shadows.
say:6:1710819005:1.source_cn: 那就是，它让那只一直藏在阴影中、操纵一切的真正黑手显形了。

say:9:1710819007:1.text: Y-Your Majesty! I-I meant no harm!
say:9:1710819007:1.source_cn: 大、大帝、我……我在！我不是有意……

say:10:1710819008:1.text: Hush. I only wish to tell you, the "trial" you witnessed last night, the battle against the Mirror Wraith... It was no miracle at all.
say:10:1710819008:1.source_cn: 嘘……我只是想告诉你，你们昨夜在圣古堂所见的试炼，那场...

say:12:1710819010:1.text: It was merely a large-scale, manipulated illusion.
say:12:1710819010:1.source_cn: 那只是一场大型的、被操控的幻觉。

say:13:1710819011:1.text: A play, meticulously staged for you by this man, Magister Cyran.
say:13:1710819011:1.source_cn: 一场由这位宫廷首席魔法师，迪尔格雷大人，为你们精心编...

say:15:1710819013:1.text: B-but he said it was destiny!
say:15:1710819013:1.source_cn: 可……可是迪尔格雷大人……明明说那是天命所归啊！

choice_prompt:16:1710819013.text: B-but he said it was destiny!
choice_prompt:16:1710819013.source_cn: 可……可是迪尔格雷大人……明明说那是天命所归啊！

say:18:1710819014:0.text: Exactly. Just like the magical barrier that covered this plaza.
say:18:1710819014:0.source_cn: 没错，就像今天这个笼罩全场的魔法护罩一样。

choice_prompt:19:1710819014.text: Exactly. Just like the magical barrier that covered this plaza.
choice_prompt:19:1710819014.source_cn: 没错，就像今天这个笼罩全场的魔法护罩一样。

say:20:1710819017:0.text: You turn to Cyran, your voice is calm, edged with quiet mockery.
say:20:1710819017:0.source_cn: 你转向迪尔格雷，声音平静，却带着一丝只有他能听懂的嘲弄。
say:20:1710819017:0.male: You turn to Cyran, your voice is calm, edged with quiet mockery.
say:20:1710819017:0.female: You turn to Cyran, your voice is calm, edged with quiet mockery.

say:21:1710819018:1.text: You gesture lightly at the shattered barrier, as though critiquing flawed artwork. It's an imitation of your magic.
say:21:1710819018:1.source_cn: 你环顾四周，仿佛在点评一件拙劣的艺术品。你指出这个护罩...
say:21:1710819018:1.male: You gesture lightly at the shattered barrier, as though critiquing flawed artwork. It's an imitation of your magic.
say:21:1710819018:1.female: You gesture lightly at the shattered barrier, as though critiquing flawed artwork. It's an imitation of your magic.

say:22:1710819019:1.text: It's just a pity. The mana nodes were slightly off, and the resonance sloppy.
say:22:1710819019:1.source_cn: 只是可惜，魔力节点有一些错漏，能量的谐振也略显粗糙。

choice_prompt:23:1710819019.text: It's just a pity. The mana nodes were slightly off, and the resonance sloppy.
choice_prompt:23:1710819019.source_cn: 只是可惜，魔力节点有一些错漏，能量的谐振也略显粗糙。

say:25:1710819020:1.source_cn: ……梅林……呵呵呵呵……我亲爱的老同学……

say:26:1710819021:1.text: Why do you always show up at the perfect moment?
say:26:1710819021:1.source_cn: 你为什么……总是来得那么及时？
say:26:1710819021:1.male: Why do you always show up at the perfect moment?
say:26:1710819021:1.female: Why do you always show up at the perfect moment?

say:27:1710819022:1.text: Always striking that self-righteous hero's pose...
say:27:1710819022:1.source_cn: 总是……摆出这副……一如既往的、令人作呕的……英雄做派！
say:27:1710819022:1.male: Always striking that self-righteous hero's pose...
say:27:1710819022:1.female: Always striking that self-righteous hero's pose...

say:29:1710819024:1.text: You haven't changed since the academy. Arrogant! Self-righteous!
say:29:1710819024:1.source_cn: 你还是和在学院时一模一样！高高在上！自以为是！
say:29:1710819024:1.male: You haven't changed since the academy. Arrogant! Self-righteous!
say:29:1710819024:1.female: You haven't changed since the academy. Arrogant! Self-righteous!

say:31:1710819026:1.text: You so-called geniuses are forever shackled by stale tradition!
say:31:1710819026:1.source_cn: 你们这些所谓的天才，永远只会被那些陈腐的正统所束缚！
say:31:1710819026:1.male: You so-called geniuses are forever shackled by stale tradition!
say:31:1710819026:1.female: You so-called geniuses are forever shackled by stale tradition!

say:32:1710819027:1.text: Everything I've done... has been to surpass your pathetic "light"!
say:32:1710819027:1.source_cn: 我所做的一切！都是为了超越你那可笑的“光明”！
say:32:1710819027:1.male: Everything I've done... has been to surpass your pathetic "light"!
say:32:1710819027:1.female: Everything I've done... has been to surpass your pathetic "light"!

say:33:1710819028:1.text: I am... I am the one who truly understands the essence of magic!
say:33:1710819028:1.source_cn: 我才是……我才是那个真正看透了魔法真谛的人！
say:33:1710819028:1.male: I am... I am the one who truly understands the essence of magic!
say:33:1710819028:1.female: I am... I am the one who truly understands the essence of magic!

say:34:1710819029:1.text: Haha... hahahaha! It ends now, Merlin! The age of orthodoxy is over!
say:34:1710819029:1.source_cn: 哈哈……哈哈哈哈！结束了，梅林！正统的时代该结束了！
say:34:1710819029:1.male: Haha... hahahaha! It ends now, Merlin! The age of orthodoxy is over!
say:34:1710819029:1.female: Haha... hahahaha! It ends now, Merlin! The age of orthodoxy is over!

choice:19:0:1.text: The barrier was Cyran's work too, wasn't it?
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 魔法护罩也是迪尔格雷的杰作吧？
choice:19:0:1.male: The barrier was Cyran's work too, wasn't it?
choice:19:0:1.female: The barrier was Cyran's work too, wasn't it?

say:36:1710819015:0.text: This barrier was no miracle. It's a crude imitation.
say:36:1710819015:0.source_cn: 这魔法罩根本不是什么神迹，这就是一个拙劣的模仿品。

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 迪尔格雷，你让我有点失望

say:37:1710819016:1.text: To think that even while plotting a conspiracy, he could only use second-hand tricks.
say:37:1710819016:1.source_cn: 没想到，他连策划一场阴谋，都只能拾人牙慧，用这种模仿来...

choice:19:2:3.source_cn: 迪尔格雷，可惜了你的剧本
